_comment: Hand-checked headshots from Sports-Reference sites for players whose league image is a placeholder (or not a headshot) and whom ESPN does not have: player id → "bbr:<Basketball-Reference id>" (NBA) or "pfr:<Pro-Football-Reference headshot file, without .jpg>" (NFL). Each was viewed (2026-11-11): a head-and-shoulders portrait, not a game photo. The owner chose this source knowing Sports-Reference discourages hotlinking; if these images stop loading, the players simply wait for another headshot. See docs/DATA.md §Photos.
